description: Test suite code for providers configuration and environment resolution in models-config.providers.nvidia, using Vitest testing framework. Contains tests for NVIDIA and Minimax providers, as well as vLLM provider.

methods.name: resolveApiKeyForProvider
methods.description: Resolves the API key configuration for a specified provider from environment variables or other sources.

methods.name: resolveImplicitProvidersForTest
methods.description: Retrieves implicitly configured providers based on environment variables and configuration files.

methods.name: withEnvAsync
methods.description: Temporarily sets environment variables for the duration of an async callback during testing.

methods.name: mkdtempSync
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory synchronously, used for setting up test environments.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins path segments into a single path string.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file asynchronously; used here to prepare configuration files for tests.
